decision_conditions: <p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved fire safety details, as per Planning Fire Safety Strategy V2 by Firntec Building Compliance (dated 29/01/2024 and Additional Fire Safety Details (email dated 30.04.24), showing compliance with London Plan Policy D12a criteria. The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in
accordance with the approved emergency evacuation details for the site, as per AEG04061_HA2_Harrow_01
- Flood Risk Evacuation Plan (dated 30/01/24); WIE12988-100-2-1-3-FRA Flood Risk
Assessment Appendices. Evacuation procedures shall be maintained as such
thereafter (unless otherwise agreed in writing), with future occupiers and site
users having easy access to the approved Flood Warning and Evacuation Plan
(FEP).</p><p>







</p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><br></p>
<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the approved Tree Survey and Impact Assessment (14/01/2022).&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the community room and flat development, details of a strategy for the provision of communal facilities for television reception (eg. aerials, dishes and other such equipment) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such details shall include the specific size and location of all equipment. The approved details shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the relevant phase and shall be retained thereafter. No other television reception equipment shall be introduced onto the walls or the roof of the building without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved details for disposal of surface and foul water, surface water attenuation, and storage works, as per Thames Water Notice of Consent (dated 25.07.24); WIE12988-100-2-1-3-FRA Flood Risk Assessment Appendices; Drawing 00001 Rev P02 Levels Design, and 5117-BROOK-ICS-RP-C-03.00 – Drainage Statement by Infrastruct CS Ltd (dated 31.07.24); and shall thereafter be retained as such.</p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">Notwithstanding the details shown on the previously approved drawings, the materials shown in the Brookside Close Presentation of Materials document (dated 1 July 2024) are to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 14px;"><br></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">1.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>facing materials for the building, including brickwork, roofing material and spandrel detail;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">2.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>windows/ doors;&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">3.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Rainwater disposal systems</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">4.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Privacy Screens</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">5.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Balustrades</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">6.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Paving and Decking</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">7.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Boundary fencing/ walls including all pedestrian/ access gates;</span></p><div><br></div>

<p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved Detailed Construction Logistics Plan by Collier Contracts (dated May 2024); ,or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p><div><br></div><p><br></p><div><br></div>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The proposed solar panels shall be carried out in accordance with the approval of details application reference PL/0156/24 and shall be retained as such thereafter.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The community use shall be only be used for the purposes specified on the application and supporting documents and for no other purpose, including any other purpose in Class F of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification).</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;">The development hereby approved shall not
be occupied until details of:</p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">a.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Location
of the cycle stores for 2 cycles within the rear garden, elevation and external
finish details for the proposed bungalows<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">b.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Capacity
of the cycle store providing a minimum of 2 long stay cycle parking spaces for
each residential dwelling and two short stay visitor cycle parking for the
proposed flats <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">c.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 2
long stay and 2 short stay cycle parking spaces for the community room <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">shall be submitted to and approved in
writing by the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be made
available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved details showing the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s),&nbsp;</span>,as per drawing 00001 Rev P02 - Levels Design,<span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;and shall thereafter be retained as such.</span></p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">2310/004/SRC/SRC - Cover Letter by Coleman Hicks (dated 24/10/24); Construction Logistics Plan by Collier Contracts (dated May 2024); Drawing Reference 00001 Rev P02 Levels Design; Planning Fire Safety Strategy V2 by Firntec Building Compliance (dated 29/01/2024); Additional Fire Safety Details (email dated 30.04.24); Thames Water Notice of Consent (dated 25.07.24); AEG04061_HA2_Harrow_01 - Flood Risk Evacuation Plan (dated 30/01/24); WIE12988-100-2-1-3-FRA Flood Risk Assessment Appendices; Brookside Close Presentation of Materials (dated 1 July 2024); Solar Panel Manufacturer’s Specification; Roof Site Plan Proposed; House Roof Plan; 5117-BROOK-ICS-RP-C-03.00 – Drainage Statement by Infrastruct CS Ltd (dated 31.07.24)</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">All other plans as approved under the original application reference P/3798/21 dated 01/06/2022, as modified by P/2659/23 (</span>non-material amendment) dated 18/10/2023.</p><div><br></div>

<p>The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until a scheme for the hard and soft landscaping details for the ground level areas have been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. Soft landscaping works shall include: planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities and an implementation programme. Replacement trees to include one large canopy species tree to mitigate for the loss of the Oak. The hard surfacing details shall include details of all furniture, boundary treatment, samples to show the texture and colour of the materials to be used and information about their sourcing/manufacturer. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the scheme so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p><div><br></div>

<p>All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building, or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.&nbsp; Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p>Before the hard surfacing hereby permitted is brought into use the surfacing shall EITHER be constructed from porous materials, for example, gravel, permeable block paving or porous asphalt, OR provision shall be made to direct run-off water from the hard surfacing to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the site.</p>

<p>Evidence of certification of Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval before any part of the development is occupied or used. The development shall only be completed and operated in accordance with any approval.</p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The development hereby permitted shall be constructed to the specifications of: "Part M, M4(2), Category 2: Accessible and Adaptable Dwellings" and 10% of the dwellings are to be constructed to the specification of "Part M4(3) wheelchair user dwellings" of the Building Regulations 2013 and thereafter retained in that form.</span></p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development in relation to the proposed bungalows which would otherwise fall within Classes A, B and E of Part 1 of Schedule 2 of that Order and Class L of Schedule 2, Part 3 Shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.</p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The community space hereby permitted shall not be used outside the following times: -</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">a:&nbsp; 09:00 hours to 22:00 hours, Monday to Sunday inclusive with the exception for days when elections are being held where it shall be 06:00 hours&nbsp; to 23:00 hours.</span></p>

<p>There shall be no amplified sound, speech or music in connection with the Community Room hereby approved which shall be audible above background noise when measured outside or inside the nearest residential property.</p>
